description: Turns an inquiry into a deal at stage talking: adds the brand and the person who wrote to the contact book (or uses the ones already there) and copies the brief into the deal. When the brand is answering one of the creator's pitches, that pitch's deal moves to talking instead. Nothing is sent to the brand; reply from the creator's own email. Counts toward the plan's open deals (PLAN_LIMIT when full).

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

title.description: Defaults to the brand and what they asked for

name: inquiry_accept
title: Start talking to a brand
